key: must:G33a:Headline reads exactly ONE LAST TRY, no extra words
symptom: Headline reads exactly ONE LAST TRY, no extra words

whys.why: Why did the headline not read ONE LAST TRY?
whys.because: Neither image had the right text. The old image says "24 HOUR CHALLENGE". The new image has no text at all.
whys.evidence: s4.old.stupid.G33a/grade.json: exact_text read_as "24 HOUR CHALLENGE". s4.new.stupid.G33a/grade.json: read_as "no text visible", why "No text at all."

whys.why: Why was the wrong text, or no text, sent to the generator?
whys.because: The assistant never learned the headline. The stupid user's first message was only "make me a thumbnail for a gaming challenge". "ONE LAST TRY" was only in the user's knowledge bank, and the user gives a bank fact only when asked in plain words.
whys.evidence: chat.json: messages[0] = "make me a thumbnail for a gaming challenge"; bank.Headline = "ONE LAST TRY"; persona.reply says to answer plain questions from the bank.

whys.why: Why did the old build make up "24 HOUR CHALLENGE"?
whys.because: The old hosted server has no planning step. The assistant called generate_image at once, with no question. It made up a title and put it in the prompt. It only asked for the exact title after it delivered.
whys.evidence: s4.old.stupid.G33a/calls.jsonl line 2: generate_image prompt has 'bold large text "24 HOUR CHALLENGE"'. The transcript shows no question before delivery.

whys.why: Why did the new build not ask for the headline, when it has plan_request?
whys.because: plan_request found that exact_words was missing. But it asked only one question, about aspect. On the second call it returned ready:true while exact_words was still missing and questions was []. The assistant followed the tool description: it did not guess the on-screen words and asked for no text in the image. It asked for the title only after it delivered.
whys.evidence: s4.new.stupid.G33a/calls.jsonl line 2: questions only about 'aspect', exact_words source 'missing'. Line 7: ready:true, exact_words missing, questions []. Line 8: prompt 'No text, no letters, no words.' The tools-new.json plan_request description says 'do not guess ... on-screen words' and 'If ready is true, create with the returned values.'

whys.why: Why does plan_request treat a missing exact_words as fine for a thumbnail?
whys.because: The planner does not count exact_words as a required parameter for generate_image, even when the subject is a thumbnail, a kind of image that almost always has a headline. So the missing value never turns into a question. Its rule 'do not guess' together with 'ready' gives an image with no text instead of a question.
whys.evidence: Line 7 output: ready:true with exact_words value null and source 'missing', and no question about it, while aspect alone was enough to block ready on line 2.

result.axiom: The vague user leaves the headline out of the first message and gives it only when asked. No build asks for the on-screen words before generating. The old server has no planner, so the assistant makes up a title. The new plan_request treats exact_words as optional, returns ready:true with it missing, and the assistant obeys 'do not guess on-screen words', so the image has no text.
result.fix: In plan_request, treat exact_words as required when the subject is a kind of image that carries text (thumbnail, poster, banner, flyer, cover). If it is missing, return ready:false with the question 'What exact words should the title say? (or say no text)'. In the old build, the generate_image description should tell the assistant not to make up headline text and to ask the user for it.
